fusions.name: Mending Touch
fusions.desc: A touch that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sure Sporing
fusions.desc: Plants a spore on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Raises mycelial helpers that fight for 20 seconds, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each kill you make while they are out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Deft Hyphae
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
